edits.old: The optional GCS prefix is prepended to a collection data-source path. Path syntax can derive fields from object names; create examples use /json/{collectionName()} with a wildcard collection name to create virtual collections dynamically. (medium confidence)
edits.new: The optional GCS store prefix is prepended to a collection data-source path to create the full path for files to ingest. Collection names can be generated dynamically from file paths by specifying * for the collection name and the collectionName() function in the path field. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/config/adf-config-file-formats.md

edits.old: Atlas Data Federation supports writing aggregation output to GCS with $out.
